steps: Slope field: horizontal along $x$-axis ($dy/dx=0$ when $y=0$), vertical along $y$-axis ($dy/dx$ undefined when $x=0$).
For $\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{y}{x}$: when $y=0$, $dy/dx=0$; when $x=0$, undefined. Matches axis behaviour.
Check quadrants: Q1 ($x>0,y>0$): $dy/dx<0$; Q2 ($x<0,y>0$): $dy/dx>0$; Q3 ($x<0,y<0$): $dy/dx<0$; Q4 ($x>0,y<0$): $dy/dx>0$. Consistent with description.
Other options: (A) and (B) give vertical on $x$-axis; (D) gives positive in Q1. Excluded.
